name: Fixes reach prod
ownerWords: 이런 느낌으로 푸쉬해줘. 모든 쓰레드에서 user intent를 분석하고, 꾸준히 발생했던 문제는 duties로 묶어야 돼.
goal: Every fix that lands on staging reaches prod within 24 h. Prod is auto-sns-agent main, which promote.yml moves only after every prod deploy and check passes, so a commit on staging and not on main has not fully reached prod even when the prod crawler already runs it. The problem kept coming back in this chat: promotes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 14 each failed at a gate, 18 lands named a failure between 10-08 and 10-19, and on 10-19 seven board steps waited a day or more for one promote while land 37 sat on staging from 10-17 22:58Z. Each run names the oldest waiting commit, the newest failed promote and land runs with the job and step that failed, and where the staging and prod crawlers' /health versions sit. The 8 in commits_on_staging_only is the busiest UTC day of staging lands from 10-01 to 10-19 (8 lands on 10-19), so more than that waiting means at least a day of lands missed prod.

metrics.label: Hours the oldest fix on staging has waited for prod
Promote runs in 24 h that failed
Commits on staging and not on prod

onMiss: Each missed metric gets exactly one live fix job, with a board step under p96 whose text starts "d4/<metric key>:" and names the failed gate from the flags: the promote_failed or land_failed run, its job and step, and the oldest_fix commit with its hours. The fix is shipped code that makes that gate pass on its own (the check, the deploy or the test it names), landed on staging through land.yml, so the release owner's next promote goes green. A promote_in_flight flag means a promote is running: set board.wake(run=<id>) and read its result after the wake instead of starting a job for the same gate. A live job that owns the failing gate (await agent_observe.list_agents()) gets the run id, job, step and hours by message; else start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd=...) and set the step's job to it, never a second copy. A source_error is fixed in this precheck first. Never dispatch, rerun or cancel a land.yml or promote.yml run, and touch no prod state; the release owner promotes as soon as staging checks out (c74). Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
